title: Hot and Cold
story: A good guessing game tells you how close you are, not just which way to go.
goal: Write heat(guess, secret): return "found" for an exact match, "hot" if the gap is 1 to 3, "warm" if 4 to 10, otherwise "cold".

tests.label: Works when the guess is above

hints: How far apart are the two numbers, ignoring which is bigger?
abs() gives the gap. Check the smallest gap first.
socratic: Why check the smallest gap before the larger ones?
What does abs(3 - 8) give? And abs(8 - 3)?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Hot and Cold”?
